how: Put back at the owner's request (24 Nov 2026: "Bring back all"): the 14 European places removed in round 2 only because Google Maps showed "Temporarily closed" with no reason or reopening date found (they may be a winter break), and Mani Sithu Market in Bagan. Each row is restored as it was before the removal, without its "ok" month: Maps showed it closed on 2026-11-24, so the card says the place is not checked and to check before going.
